Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "name,score\n\"Rao, A\",8\nMina,11\n"
  ],
  "expected": 19
}

Example

  "args": [
    "name,score\n"
  ],
  "expected": 0
}
Hint

DictReader exposes fields by their header names.

Complexity: O(input length) time and space
